verdict.reasons: The candidate correctly features a single white-and-blue upright cylindrical AFP drip-tape carton roll matching the approved identity. The main AFP logo and 'Drip Irrigation Tape' text are authentic, legible, and consistent with owner-approved sleeve captions. The mandatory 'AFP | 09134922013' watermark is present and exact. The irrigation setup features continuous thin flattened laterals typical of drip tape, running through neutral small seedlings without visual contradictions. While the loose coil of black material next to the carton is slightly thicker than ideal tape representation, it accurately depicts 'ordinary line contact' and minor framing imperfections are advisory only. No people, mixed product families, or core defects are present, comfortably meeting the minimum score threshold.

focused_physical_review.reason: A line emerges directly from the bottom-right of the package base and crosses underneath the black coiled product located to the right. While the black coil appears to be a distinct uninstalled roll, it remains physically entangled with the continuous line emerging from the package. No soil gap is visible around the package's right side due to this contact.
